Alex (Sales): Hey team — heads-up: UK fintech POC (Acorn Bank) asking for a 48h breach-notify SLA and the usual CAIQ/SIG pack. Sales needs a clear answer for the contract. Can we commit to 48h for customer notifications?
Priya (Security): Short answer: our standard playbook is initial acknowledgement within ~4h and a full notification for confirmed customer-impacting breaches within 72h. 48h is negotiable for a POC but requires Legal + Ops signoff, an agreed runbook, and guaranteed access to logs/forensics.
Jordan (Legal): We can consider 48h if we narrow definitions. Suggested clause: `Redwood will notify Customer of confirmed unauthorized access to Customer Data within 48 hours of confirmation; Redwood will provide an initial acknowledgement within 4 hours of detection and periodic updates thereafter.` Need to define "confirmed" vs "suspected" and list notification recipients.
Mei (Solutions): CAIQ & SIG are ready — sharing link: https://redwood.internal/caiq (internal). Recommend a short tabletop with Acorn before signing so expectations align on what information we'll share. I can schedule.
Sam (Eng Oncall): Operational note: to reliably meet 48h we need preserved logs (90d retention), on-demand packet capture, KMS audit export, and a named oncall lead for the POC. For hosted POC it's doable but requires enabling extended logging & storage (billing/ops change). Private/VPC makes this simpler.
Alex (Sales): Customer will push hard on contract language. Can Product/Eng commit to turning on the logging/forensics for a POC and confirm ETA?
Ben (Product): We can enable extended retention and a forensics addon for POCs as opt-in. We'll gate behind feature flags `poc-extended-logs` and `poc-forensics`. ETA to enable for a single org: ~3 business days after contract exec. Likely billable.
Priya (Security): Also callout: GDPR/UK-GDPR requires supervisory authority notification (ICO) within 72h for reportable breaches. That legal/regulatory window doesn't change; the 48h customer-notify is an internal contractual commitment and must not be framed as regulatory compliance.
Jordan (Legal): Agreed. Draft will separate `Customer Notification` (48h SLA for confirmed incidents) from `Regulatory Reporting` (as required by applicable law). Include minimum content we will provide (scope, indicators, mitigations) and a forensic evidence request process (NDA + S3 presigned artifacts or access).
Mei (Solutions): I'll assemble: 1) sample notification template, 2) runbook checklist we require, 3) CAIQ/SIG bundle, and 4) a short tabletop agenda. Can we target sharing by EOD Tuesday?
Alex (Sales): :thumbsup: Customer needs sign-off this week — Tuesday EOD would be perfect. Also flag any additional costs so I can update pricing.
incident-bot: Open incident prep ticket created for POC security prep — https://incidents.redwood/2039991111 (internal).
